# SheetJS CE

`xlsx-0.20.3.min.js` is the unmodified SheetJS CE 0.20.3 browser bundle from
https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js.
Its Apache-2.0 license is included in `xlsx-LICENSE.txt`.

Only the statistics import worker loads it. Workbooks remain in the browser
until the reduced upload is submitted to the application's authenticated API.
